convention_rule: Four objects in a left-to-right row map to P1-P4; the single object singled out (green light, alive or occupied) marks the target.
basis: A: four planters, only the 4th (rightmost) has a living flowering plant lit by a green lamp. B: four birdhouses, only the 4th is larger, green-lit, with a bird on it. Both images independently mark position 4. P4 is not client-correct (P2 is).
